sentences.en: We have yet to discover an effective remedy for cancer.
sentences.zh: 我们还没有找到有效的癌症治疗方法。

sentences.en: The more you study, the more you discover your ignorance.
sentences.zh: 你学得越多，就越会发现自己知道得太少。

sentences.en: The reasons for this neglect are not hard to discover.
sentences.zh: 这种忽视的原因不难找出。

mnemonic: 词根记忆：dis（除去）+cover（盖）→除去覆盖物→发现
